--- layout: default type_slug: ohlc title: OHLC Chart in C# — Open-High-Low-Close Bars as SVG nav_title: OHLC Chart description: Draw OHLC bar charts in C# with AddOhlc and OhlcPoint — high-low bars with open and close ticks, rendered as self-contained SVG from .NET. permalink: /chart/types/ohlc/ doc_section: Chart Reporting doc_section_url: /chart/ generated_by: scripts/split_showcase.py --- {% capture specimen %} {% endcapture %} {% capture snippet %}{% highlight csharp %}{% raw %} using TerraFluent.Chart.Reporting.Models; string svg = ChartBuilder.Create() .Title("ACME — OHLC Bars") .Size(720, 420) .XAxis("Day", "Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri") .YAxis("Price ($)") .AsAnimated() .Series(s => s .AddOhlc("ACME", new[] { new OhlcPoint(120, 128, 118, 126), new OhlcPoint(126, 130, 122, 123), new OhlcPoint(123, 133, 121, 132), new OhlcPoint(132, 135, 128, 129), new OhlcPoint(129, 140, 127, 138), })) .RenderToSvg(); {% endraw %}{% endhighlight %}{% endcapture %} {% include chart-type-page.html slug=page.type_slug specimen=specimen snippet=snippet %}
